recommended_approach: Use Blender’s Mantaflow liquid workflow via the Python API types exposed on fluid objects/modifiers: configure the simulation domain through `bpy.types.FluidDomainSettings` (notably the FLIP-related control `flip_ratio`), and configure the emitter/inflow through `bpy.types.FluidFlowSettings` (including per-flow noise inputs like `noise_texture`). For additional small-scale motion detail, use the domain noise controls exposed on `bpy.types.FluidDomainSettings` (e.g., `noise_strength`, `noise_time_anim`) to drive higher-frequency surface variation on top of the main FLIP motion.

noise_time_anim.recommended_start: TBD (enable/adjust if using animated noise detail)

noise_texture.recommended_start: Optional (assign a texture if using per-flow noise modulation)
